## Factory facts (SGS Production & Trading Assessment, 2026-08-17)

- Floor space: 5,000 m2
- Production lines: 5 (2 supervisors, 48 operators)
- Staff: 69 total (55 full-time, 14 part-time); production 50, QC 4, sales 7
- Machines: 24 units across 12 types
- Subcontracting: none — all eight production steps run in house
- QC: 4 inspectors covering all lines; finished goods by random inspection; written instructions and records kept; lot traceability to main raw material; closed-loop corrective action
- Lead time: 20 days average (order confirmation to delivery); shortest sample 7 days
- Ports: Shantou, Shenzhen
- Terms: FOB, CIF, EXW, CFR; payment L/C, T/T, PayPal, Western Union, Credit card, Cash, MoneyGram
- Export experience: 8 years, 5 trade staff
- Markets: North America 40%, Eastern Europe 20%, South America 10%, Middle East 10%, Western Europe 10%, South Asia 10%
- Clients: Brand owners, Retailers, Wholesalers
- Not claimed anywhere on the site: ISO 9001, BSCI, SEDEX, GSV, GMPC, or any certificate held for the catalogue as a whole. Testing is per model and per market.

## Bubble Toys (10 models)

### TF200892 — Industrial Garden Lamp Bubble Machine - High-Volume Outdoor Edition

URL: https://toyfactoryglobal.com/product/TF200892
Unit price: USD 4.34/pc ex-works. MOQ 72 pcs.
Specs: Packaging 19 x 13 x 28.5 cm · Carton 87 x 41 x 78.5 cm · 36 PCS pcs/carton · Inner 0 PCS · G.W./N.W. 26.6 / 24.5 KG · 0.28 CBM

The TF200892 is a bubble machine built into a garden-lamp silhouette. A lamp-shaped head sits on a white pole with a round base, and a clear funnel under the head is where the bubbles leave the unit. The front of the head is gridded and printed BUBBLE / GARDEN LAMP, a switch sits on the side of the head, and the head carries sound and light effects. The pole is height-adjustable, which is what lets the same unit work on a patio table and on a lawn. It is supplied in several colorways, and the photographs on this page show a group of units standing together beside a pool, which is how the product is actually merchandised.

Visible in the photos:
- Lamp-shaped head mounted on a height-adjustable pole with a round base, so it stands without being held
- Clear funnel-shaped outlet under the head marks where the bubbles leave the unit
- Gridded front panel printed BUBBLE / GARDEN LAMP
- Side-mounted switch on the head

### TF200888 — Sunflower Multi-Hole Electric Bubble Gun - Professional Event Edition

URL: https://toyfactoryglobal.com/product/TF200888
Unit price: USD 3.65/pc ex-works. MOQ 96 pcs.
Specs: Packaging 12.4 x 12.4 x 28.3 cm · Carton 86.5 x 51.5 x 52 cm · 48 PCS pcs/carton · Inner 0 PCS · G.W./N.W. 20.9 / 18.9 KG · 0.232 CBM

The TF200888 is a sunflower built as a self-supporting unit. A yellow flower head with a perforated centre disc sits on a green stem with two leaves, and the stem is planted in a green pot that acts as the base. The bubble output comes from the perforated disc in the middle of the flower rather than from a separate nozzle, so the head itself is the emitter and the whole silhouette stays recognisable while the unit is running. The model is listed as the Professional Event Edition, which is the way it is positioned commercially: as equipment that a venue, an events company or a party planner puts out repeatedly rather than as a toy bought once.

Visible in the photos:
- Sunflower head with a perforated centre disc, which is where the bubbles come out
- Green stem with two moulded leaves
- Green pot moulded as the base of the unit, so it stands without a pole or bracket
- Single-piece body with no assembly between pot, stem and head

The TF213301 is a standing garden light that makes bubbles. ## Water Guns (15 models)

### TF210951 — Space Ring Fire-Breathing Automatic Water Gun (Blue)

URL: https://toyfactoryglobal.com/product/TF210951
Unit price: USD 5.31/pc ex-works. MOQ 180 pcs.
Specs: Packaging 21.5 x 9 x 19 cm · Carton 58 x 44 x 59.5 cm · 36 PCS pcs/carton · Inner Colour Box · G.W./N.W. 13.5 / 12 KG · 0.152 CBM

The TF210951 makes the water tank the shape of the product. Behind the grip sits a large open ring, moulded in transparent blue, and that ring is the reservoir rather than a decorative frame, so the water level is visible from the side while the gun is in use. The body above it carries SHARK and WATER GUN markings and CASE EJECTION on the rear flank, an accessory rail runs along the top, and the muzzle carries the LED flame effect. It is the most sculptural of the pistol forms here, and the ring is the reason: a customer picks it up because the silhouette is unusual, not because the specification is different.

Visible in the photos:
- Large open ring reservoir behind the grip, in transparent blue
- Water level visible through the ring from the side
- SHARK and WATER GUN markings on the body, CASE EJECTION on the rear flank
- Accessory rail along the top line

The TF211492 is the model that fires water and bubbles at the same time from the front of the unit rather than from opposite ends. The muzzle throws the water jet through a lit flame effect, and a cylindrical orange module slung under the barrel releases a cluster of bubbles from a perforated front disc, so the child gets both streams from one trigger pull. MACHINE BUBBLE GUN is printed on the flank and the body is a dark grey with orange accents, which is a more muted finish than the transparent blue used across most of the water range.

Visible in the photos:
- Water from the muzzle through a lit flame effect, and bubbles from a perforated disc on the module under the barrel
- Both functions run from the front, so the streams can be fired together
- MACHINE BUBBLE GUN printed on the flank, dark grey body with orange accents
- Drum reservoir under the grip

The TF169193 is a modular construction kit in light-blue plastic with a small solar panel that clips on top of whatever the child builds. The twelve configurations shown across the product photographs run from a four-wheeled rover with large spoked wheels to a walking frame, a paddle boat and a pair of wheel-on-wheel designs, and each one is assembled from the same set of beams, plates, pins and gears. Because the panel is the power source, the model does not need a battery compartment, which is the single fact that makes this kit easy to ship and easy to give to a parent who does not want another battery in the house.
